props.eyebrow: Wedding and event music at a Boulder hotel
props.title: Hotel Boulderado
props.lede: Hotel Boulderado opened with a New Year’s Eve ball in 1909, a block from Pearl Street, and couples still get married on its Grand Staircase under the stained-glass ceiling.

headingText.html: Live music is part of the hotel already. There’s jazz in the lobby on Friday evenings, and music every week downstairs at License No. 1.

props.title: Live music in each Hotel Boulderado event space
props.lede: Here’s the act we’d pick for each space. Press play to hear it over the photo.

spaces.name: Mezzanine and the Grand Staircase
spaces.facts: The Mezzanine Lounge is about 3,300 sq ft under the stained-glass ceiling, for dinners of up to 80 and receptions of up to 110. Ceremonies happen on the Grand Staircase, with up to 180 guests watching from the Mezzanine.
spaces.why: A solo violin to a full string quartet, from the ceremony through dinner.
spaces.alt: A long dinner table with flowers on the Mezzanine, under the stained-glass ceiling.

spaces.name: Boulderado Ballroom
spaces.facts: The Boulderado Ballroom is about 2,900 sq ft, for dinners of up to 180 and receptions of up to 250. The ceiling is lower than most ballrooms, at about 8 ft 8 in.
spaces.why: He can start as a duo and grow to a full band over the evening.
spaces.alt: The Boulderado Ballroom set theater-style, with rows of chairs facing projection screens.

spaces.name: Columbine-Balsam
spaces.facts: Columbine-Balsam is about 2,200 sq ft, for dinners of up to 120 and receptions of up to 175, and Columbine on its own holds dinners of up to 80.
spaces.why: Upright bass and guitar, at a volume nobody has to raise their voice over.
spaces.alt: The Columbine room set with tables in a U shape facing a projection screen.

spaces.name: Spruce and the Corner Bar
spaces.facts: Spruce Farm & Fish and the Corner Bar each host private brunches and dinners of up to 30.
spaces.why: One guitarist playing blues, jazz and Spanish flavors, soft enough to keep talking.
spaces.stat: Brunches and dinners of up to 30

rows.text: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The ballroom’s ceiling is low, so we size the band and the sound to fit it.
The hotel caters every event in-house, and its wedding packages include a dance floor.
There’s jazz in the lobby on Friday evenings, so we’ll plan your music around it.
The hotel lights a 29-foot Christmas tree in the lobby each year, and it hosts holiday teas and buffets.
Parking at the hotel is valet only, with street parking nearby.

props.html: Forward this list to the events team, or send us the answers and we’ll plan around them.
Questions about music at Hotel Boulderado

items.q: Can we bring our own band to a wedding at Hotel Boulderado?
items.a: Hotels like Hotel Boulderado generally let you book your own entertainment, within their rules on insurance, load-in and sound. Your event manager can confirm them for your date, and we send a certificate of insurance with every booking.

items.q: Does the band need the hotel’s AV team?
items.a: Our acts bring their own sound system, sized to the space. The hotel’s AV team can add anything beyond that, and we’ll work out the details with your event manager.

items.q: Can one act play the ceremony, the cocktail hour and the reception?
items.a: Yes. The same act can move with you from The Grand Staircase to The Mezzanine to The Boulderado Ballroom, and one booking covers all of it.

items.q: How much does live music add to a wedding at Hotel Boulderado?
items.a: It depends on the size of the act and how much of the day it covers. Our pricing page has what live music costs in the Colorado market, and we’ll send a quote for your date.
